scope: Closed v2 read/page and inbound event codecs; first-epoch verification under independently supplied authority. No receive storage activation, browser, service route or enrollment.

generated.oracle: Authored Yjs updates, independent Node/OpenSSL signatures and canonical event bytes; live/stored equality and independently re-signed actor rejection.
One nonzero XOR mutation of a page byte must be refused. Reproduce from the test and seed; individual mutations are not separately saved.
Existing preparation model external source/receipt ledger, atomic model cuts and pending Yjs replay.

implementation_defect.finding: Replacing lifetime.assertCurrent during crypto could bypass closure because the callback property was consulted repeatedly.
implementation_defect.repair: Capture and bind the original lifetime assertion and clock callbacks once before crypto.
implementation_defect.after: The directed regression passes in codecs.log, results.xml and the full unit suite.

harness_repair: Regression output initially overwrote generated.json. The final runner isolates regression-artifacts; both 400 codec inputs and 300 prior model histories are now preserved.
limits: Synthetic independently supplied membership, genesis and generation authority do not establish real issuance or semantic baseline admission.
Stored verification covers one original event, not native AEAD, complete witness census or content coverage.
No v9 reader fence, native transaction, crash campaign, editor promotion, real service reader route or fresh enrollment is enabled.
Only creating publisher at epoch 1/generation 1; no general lineage advancement, finalization or concurrent-writer authority.
Generated campaign found no additional defect; bounded examples and effective controls are not a whole-protocol correctness proof.

The registered Node runner ran directly. No successful whole pnpm check is claimed.
